program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((divs (filter (lambda (c)
                         (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                       (range 0 (cols g))))
         (d1 (first divs))
         (d2 (second divs)))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) d1
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((a (at g r c))
              (b (at g r (+ d1 1 c)))
              (x (at g r (+ d2 1 c))))
          (cond [(and (not (= a 0)) (or (= a b) (= a x))) a]
                [(and (not (= b 0)) (= b x)) b]
                [else 0]))))))
